d:
Some journeys cannot be measured in miles.
From India to Glasgow. From tradition to tomorrow.
It was an honour to perform Chanakya and Tandavam at the Commonwealth Games Handover Ceremony, as the baton was passed to Ahmedabad for 2030.
The sitar has travelled across centuries, cultures and continents. To watch its voice resonate on a stage shared with the world was deeply humbling.
May our music continue to remind us that heritage is not something we preserve behind us. It is something we carry forward.
With gratitude.
